title: Phrases
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Use a short invitation, then answer clearly. Add a day and time so both people know the plan.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Tu veux aller au concert vendredi ?
steps.en: Do you want to go to the concert on Friday?
steps.tip: Say it: tü vuh ah-LAY oh kohn-SEHR vah(n)-druh-DEE

steps.en: Do you want to go skating?
steps.tip: Say it: tü vuh ah-LAY pah-tee-NAY

steps.fr: Désolé, je ne peux pas samedi.
steps.tip: Say it: day-zoh-LAY zhuh nuh puh pah sahm-DEE
Say it: zhuh swee leebr dee-MAH(N)sh

steps.fr: On va à la cabane à sucre.
steps.en: We are going to the sugar shack.
steps.tip: Say it: ohn vah ah lah kah-BAHN ah SÜKR

steps.fr: Le match commence à dix-neuf heures.
steps.en: The game starts at seven p.m.
steps.tip: Say it: luh match koh-mah(n)s ah deez-nuhv uhr
Say it: zhuh pray-FEHR ruh-gahr-DAY uh(n) feelm

steps.fr: On va au parc à quinze heures.
steps.en: We are going to the park at three p.m.
steps.tip: Say it: ohn vah oh park ah kah(n)z uhr
